europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis

europe_now.title: Energy and Environment
europe_now.summary: Extreme heat and drought conditions have forced the shutdown of a nuclear plant in Hungary. Low water levels in the Danube River are also threatening power generation in Romania and Hungary.
